The Brooklyn Dispatch

An independent publication about films, books, music and the places they lead.

About The Brooklyn Dispatch

The Brooklyn Dispatch began from a simple observation. The experience of art rarely ends when the credits roll or the final page is turned. The conversations, journeys and habits that follow are often just as interesting as the work itself.

This publication explores those afterlives.

Founding Editor

Steve Berkowitz

I grew up in London, England and, after living across the American Midwest and West Coast, I now live on the East Coast in Brooklyn, New York. I previously lived in Philadelphia.

I've always been interested in the ways films, books and music shape how we experience places, conversations and everyday life. Over the years I found myself keeping notes after finishing a novel, leaving the cinema or discovering a new album.

The Brooklyn Dispatch grew naturally from that habit. It is a place to collect essays, notebooks and an evolving shelf of films, books, music and places that continue the conversation.
